text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Jan 20 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 3 due by 30/1, approx. 1 days delay expected.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 22 due by 4/2, approx. 1 days delay expected.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 10 due by 7/2, approx. 1 days delay expected.

Gladstone - R.G Tanna - Terminal to undergo maintenance as follows, shiploader no.1 from 07.00-17.00 hrs. 23/1, shiploader no.2, from 07.00-17.00 hrs. 24/1. One shiploader will be operational during this period. One vessel awaiting cargo, 1 waiting, 14 due by 17/1, no delays.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel due 24/1, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 28/2, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 19 due by 4/2, approx. 4-5 days delay expected. Channel (dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 4 waiting, 18 due, approx. 4-5 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Berth vacant, 4 vessels awaiting cargo, 10 due by 20/2, approx. 2-3 days delay expected.

IRON ORE - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 2 due by 24/1. B berth, 1 vessel loading, 4 anchored, 2 due by 24/1, 7 others due by 5/2, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 vessel ue by 30/1.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 3 due by 22/1.
East Intercourse Island - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due by 20/1. Dampier line-up - 10 Vessels due by 10/2 of which 7 for Parker Point, 3 for East Intercourse island.
Port Walcott - Nine vessels due by 2/2.
Jan 22 - GRAIN - Queensland - Mackay - No vessels due. No shipping operations will take place on 27/1 (Australia day).
Gladstone - One vessel due on 3/2. Shiploading is available if required on Australia day.
Brisbane - One wheat vessel in port, 4 wheat vessels due by 31/1. Ship loading will continue as normal on Australia day.
New South Wales - Newcastle - One wheat vessel in port, 3 vessels due by 29/1. No ship loading on Australia day.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading barley, 6 vessels due by 10/2. Shiploading as normal on Australia day.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel in port, 10 vessels due on 10/2. Mua and Vicgrain will work on Australia day at holiday rates.
Portland - One vessel loading barley, 1 wheat vessel in port, 8 vessels due by 12/2. Vicgrain advise that terminal will operate on Australia day if requested.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - Six vessels due by 1/2.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading barley, 1 beans vessel in port, 5 vessels due by 3/2.
Thevenard - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel due 1/2.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading, 9 wheat vessels due by 6/2.
Wallaroo - Five wheat vessels due by 4/2.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - One vessel loading barley, 6 vessels due by 12/2.
In all South Australian grain ports, labour is available at ordinary public holiday rates on Australia day.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Grain berth to close from 15/1 for a period of 5-6 weeks for major berth reconstruction.
Kwinana - One vessels loading wheat, 2 wheat vessels in port, 5 wheat vessels due by 10/2.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel in port, 7 vessels due by 14/2.
Esperance - One vessel loading wheat, 4 vessels due by 15/2.
In all Western Australian grain ports, terminals advise that labour is available at overtime rates on Australia day.
